plainText:
Ayako Shiraishi (Japanese: 白石文子 Shiraishi Ayako) was a Japanese voice actress for .

==Biography==
Shiraishi was born on April 13, 1963 in , . She started work during in Pokémon Emergency! as Nurse Joy. She retired in 2002, passing the role on to Yuriko Yamaguchi. Her last episode was EP229.
